|strategy=By [mailto:joea@decipher.com Joe Alread, Decipher Game Designer]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/naboofighterpilot.html</ref>

Your standard, non-unique pilot is not usually something a player would be very excited about. But when compared to other non-unique characters, the [[Naboo Fighter Pilot]] provides a big bang for the buck.

While his numbers aren't all that great, his strength comes in his game text. He deploys for free to [[Naboo]]. That ability alone could warrant using this pilot in a [[Naboo]]-themed deck, but it gets even better than that. If you deploy him aboard an N-1, you actually get to activate a Force! Deploy a card with ability to activate a Force; this character's deploy cost is essentially less than zero! His forfeit also goes up to four when he's aboard an N-1: not bad at all for a non-unique character.

Combo:

Spend a Force to deploy a Fighter, get the one Force back with the pilot, rinse and repeat as many times as necessary = LOTS of power for FREE.
